740870201.text: Is this where researchers spent their downtime? Is this even humane? Has the Fontaine Research Institute ever considered making renovating this place a priority?

740870202.text: ...There should be a Survey Anchor here. Just like Ms. Chronie implied, this place needs renovation, and the power supply here is very limited... Or perhaps I should say, there's a complete shortage.

740870203.text: #While I'm answering Ms. Chronie's questions, I'll leave the job of recovering the Survey Anchor to you, {NICKNAME}.

740870301.text: Compared to some other areas, the dormitories weren't impacted as much by the explosion.

740870302.text: Dormitories? But I don't see even one bed here, so how do the researchers get any rest? It's not like they can sleep in chairs, right?

740870303.text: Ms. Chronie, your idea of "resting" is very different from that of the researchers.

740870304.text: When a researcher at the Fontaine Research Institute says they need rest, they only want a quick break for their brain.

740870305.text: Then, they would usually come here, play piano, read, and have a drink or two if necessary.

740870306.text: Uh, but wouldn't sleeping provide more rest for the brain?

740870307.text: You may be correct, but... To our researchers, sleeping is a waste of time in the first place.

740870308.text: Sleeping is a waste of time? No, it is essential for rest!

740870309.text: Sleeping completely cuts your train of thought short, and that's just not acceptable for our research work.

740870312.text: Are you being serious? If you don't sleep, the only thing that'll be cut short is your life!

740870313.text: Not necessarily. The institute boasts an excellent health care system that guarantees researchers' health and well-being.

740870314.text: But that's still no reason to not sleep!

740870315.text: Also, if researchers are here to give their brains a break, wouldn't that break their thought process from research, anyway?

740870316.text: Not necessarily. It only seems like they're taking a break when actually, they're still pondering different academic subjects subconsciously.

740870317.text: It's akin to a vast ocean that, while appearing calm on the surface, still has a strong undercurrent beneath.

740870318.text: Sometimes, the undercurrents below are much stronger than the towering waves above.

740870319.text: I get it. You mean when researchers of the Fontaine Research Institute are on a project, they must keep working and are not allowed to rest, right?

740870320.text: That is not completely fair to say. If they truly need sleep, they're free to go back home and do just that.

740870321.text: So, it is fairer to say that as long as researchers of the Fontaine Research Institute are inside the Institute, they must keep working and are not allowed to rest.

740870322.text: Your rhetoric is simply astound, Ms. Chronie.
